description_expanded: This new addition to the Alys Beach vacation rental program is located in the Caliza Court building directly across from the Caliza Pool Complex and a very short walk to the emerging Town Center. The first floor of the main part of the home offers a great room with a living room and dining area just off of the kitchen as well as a half-bath. As you ascend the stairs, you will reach first find the second bedroom with a private bath and offering a twin bed and a set of bunk beds with an additional trundle bed. Continuing up the stairs, you will reach the primary bedroom with a king-sized bed and ensuite bathroom. Leading outside from the great room, guests will find a private courtyard with a plunge pool and a propane grill for your convenience. The third bedroom is detached from the main house and offers a covered patio with an outdoor sitting area as well as a king-sized bed and private bath. Parking for this home is located in a one-vehicle garage as well as a designated parking space behind the home. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations. Pet Policy for this dog-friendly home -- We are pleased to welcome up to two well-mannered dogs (eighty pounds max per dog, please) per home, allowing your entire family—paws included—to enjoy the Alys Beach experience. For the comfort and safety of all guests, dogs must remain leashed in public spaces and be current on vaccinations. Kindly observe proper pet etiquette by cleaning up after your dog and utilizing the conveniently located waste stations throughout the community. Guests with more assertive dogs are encouraged to consider the use of a gentle muzzle in shared spaces, out of consideration for neighbors and fellow guests. Please note that dogs are not permitted on the beach – only Walton County residents may secure a dog permit for their furry friends. Many of our outdoor dining areas are pet-friendly; however, we recommend calling ahead to confirm individual merchant policies. Should you need local pet services—from dog walkers to veterinarians—our concierge is delighted to assist. A non-refundable pet fee of $350 applies.
